SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rtrim(o.status)) = 'shipped' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_amt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rtrim(o.status)) = 'pending' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS pending_amt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rtrim(o.status)) = 'cancelled' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_amt,
    MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }} c
LEFT JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id

explanation: This procedure builds a per-customer order summary. For every customer, it totals order amounts by status (shipped, pending, cancelled), finds the most recent order date, and counts orders. Customers with no orders still appear, with zero totals and a count of zero. The result replaces the existing dbo.customer_scorecard table.
